title: Felicia Stancil's 2012 Worlds GT
subtitle: Achievement verified; exact surviving bicycle remains under authentication.
summary: Lititz BMX artifact 26.0054 is strongly attributed as Felicia Stancil's 2012 Worlds GT Speed Series bicycle with a W1 plate. Official reporting verifies her Junior Women time-trial and race world titles in Birmingham. The exact surviving frame, plate and race-day component configuration remain under authentication.

claims.statement: Felicia Stancil won both the Junior Women time-trial and race world titles in Birmingham in 2012.
claims.public_wording: Official USA BMX reporting verifies Felicia Stancil's Junior Women time-trial and race world titles at the 2012 UCI BMX World Championships in Birmingham.
claims.evidence_summary: USA BMX identifies Stancil as the Factory GT rider who won the time-trial superfinal and the Junior Women race title.
claims.does_not_prove: The result does not by itself authenticate the surviving Lititz BMX frame, W1 plate or current component configuration.

claims.statement: Artifact 26.0054 is the exact bicycle Stancil used for the 2012 world-title performances.
claims.public_wording: Artifact 26.0054 is strongly attributed as Stancil's 2012 Worlds GT Speed Series bicycle, but exact frame and race-day configuration authentication remains open.
claims.evidence_summary: The Lititz inventory, W1 plate and collection provenance create a strong attribution; serial, plate-reverse, transfer and race-day visual evidence are still required.
claims.does_not_prove: The present attribution does not establish that every current component was fitted during both championship rides.

timeline.event: Stancil won the Junior Women time-trial superfinal.
Stancil won the Junior Women race world title.
